## AI Fingerprint V8.8.5
AI Fingerprint is an integrated document-analysis and authorship-evidence framework combining:
- multi-engine AI-generated-text analysis
- dependency-aware consensus arbitration
- OCR
- DOCX/OOXML forensics
- PDF forensics
- cryptographic provenance verification
- temporal reconstruction
- auditable evidence ledger

The protected source code and private implementation are not published on this website.
